mapper.select: select t.id as moduleTableId, s.action_sql, s.action_type, t.is_main, t.is_child, s.table_name, td.datasource_id as dataSourceId, t.module_id, mi.module_type, mi.module_bean, mi.module_method, mi.api_url, mi.api_type from cfg_module_table t left join cfg_module_info mi on t.module_id = mi.id left join cfg_table_definition td on t.table_id = td.id inner join cfg_module_sql s on t.module_id = s.module_id and t.id = s.module_table_id where t.module_id in (select module_id from cfg_module_api where id = #{serviceId}) and s.action_type in #{item}

select t.module_table_id as moduleTableId, t.module_id as moduleId, t.action_sql as actionSql, t.action_type as actionType, t.table_name as tableName, mt.table_alias as tableAlias, mt.is_main as isMain from cfg_module_sql t left join cfg_module_table mt on t.module_table_id = mt.id where t.deleted=0
and t.module_id = #{moduleId}
